Enlarge screenshot: Put modules on matching buildings

native.text: Modules upgrade a matching existing structure; select an eligible highlighted target. Captured in v0.64; these menu controls remain current. · Tap image to enlarge.
Open BUILD → MODULES and select the available factory, research or power upgrade you want.
Tap a completed matching building with a free module slot. The guidance distinguishes eligible buildings, queued upgrades and full buildings.
Let the assigned constructor reach and upgrade the target. Check the queue if the job is waiting for power or the builder is lost.
Modules do not go on empty terrain, unfinished foundations, the wrong building type or a building that already has its maximum modules.
